NIST_MBE_PMI_1.stp is the public-domain AP203 conversion of NIST MBE PMI
test model 1. The accompanying README is the upstream notice. Both files
come from [BRL-CAD at cb1311a](https://github.com/BRL-CAD/brlcad/tree/cb1311a91fc5d512b5703cd77640d88f040eb690/db/nist).

capped-cylinder.step is authored for this project under GPL-3.0-or-later.
The AP242 solid has a 10 mm radius and 25 mm height. Its wall uses the seam
edge twice. Each planar cap has one full-circle bound.

The GPL-3.0-or-later fixtures generated by the built_step example
`author_exchange_corpus` exercise the following cases.

| File | Source geometry in millimetres | Expected import |
| --- | --- | --- |
| cavity.step | A 20 mm tetrahedron enclosing a reversed 3 mm tetrahedral shell | One solid, eight faces, volume (8000 − 27) / 6 mm³ |
| display-mesh.step | One triangle in an AP242 tessellated solid | One faceted body |
| mixed-parts.step | The cavity solid and one translated occurrence of the triangle | One exact and one faceted body in two definitions |

`seam-pcurves-ap214.step` is an authored GPL-3.0-or-later AP214 cylinder
with distinct linear pcurves at zero and one full turn. The regression
also moves the second pcurve off the seam and checks rejection.

`rational-sheet.step` is an authored GPL-3.0-or-later quadratic-by-linear
NURBS surface with two rational boundary curves. Its middle weight is 0.75.
